newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-OUTSCHAKOV WINS INCONCLUSIVE MOUNTAIN STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-OUTSCHAKOV WINS INCONCLUSIVE MOUNTAIN STAGE.

text.p: The third stage of the Tour of Catalonia, won by Sergei Outschakov of Ukraine on Saturday, brought the riders their first taste of the mountains but failed to prove decisive.
Briton Chris Boardman maintained the overall lead he has held since Thursday's time trial.
The heat of the day made the climbers reluctant to show their strength until 25km from the line in the last mountain stretch through the sierra of Montserrat.
Luc Leblanc built up a 20 second lead but was caught on the descent by another French rider, Armanda de las Cuevas, who was then joined by Dutchman Bart Voskamp.
Voskamp looked set to take the stage until the final kilometres but he was hauled in by the Kelme team and Polti's Outschakov was on hand to find a way through to the line.
The Tour continues on Sunday with the 130km fourth stage between San Juan Despi and Barcelona, where a sprint finish is expected.
